sources.title: Broncos’ have one of the best safety duos in the NFL… when healthy
sources.description: There were a couple of tweets on safety play in the NFL dropped and despite a rough few weeks with missed tackles, the Denver Broncos have arguably the best or second best duo in the whole league in Talanoa Hufanga and Brandon Jones. The first came from Gridiron Grading on what they call “Havoc plays” […]
